note: Prompts people actually type, per skill. train prompts are for tuning a description (python3 scripts/triggers.py shows their misses); test prompts are held out and are the only ones judged: check.py fails when fewer test prompts pick the skill first than min_rank1 (default: every test prompt), or a negative prompt picks it more often than max_negative_hits (default 0). Write a test prompt before changing the description it judges, and never reword one to pass. A miss is fixed in the description. Floors record a skill that doesn't pass yet; they only go up. A test prompt the descriptions were tuned on moves to train, and the fresh test split that replaces it starts its floors at today's value on it. similar_pairs lists description pairs allowed above max_similarity.
